record_scope_reconstruction: Reuters identifies Shushme commercial freight on the Halabja–Kermanshah corridor, separate from the three main official Iranian–Kurdistan posts.

source_checks.finding: Original shotlist/interviews identify Shushme, 28 February closure and resumed screened commercial trucks. Exact chronology remains contested.
Later report distinguishes the pre-existing freight crossing from later tourist expansion and names Halabja/Kermanshah. Useful identity evidence, not 2020 reopening proof.
